01

Compare like with like

Bring your Loan Estimate and your questions. We will review how the loan terms and costs fit your goals.

02

Ask about the differences

The headline rate does not tell the whole story. Ask about points, fees, mortgage insurance, and the cash you need at closing.

03

Share documents securely

Contact Erik first to arrange a secure way to share your Loan Estimate. Do not send Social Security numbers, bank statements, or unredacted loan documents by ordinary email.
